# Saalim Zayed

> Official website of Saalim Zayed — entrepreneur, author, e-commerce and middleman business activist, and CEO of Hukm Qalbi.

Saalim Zayed, born in 2012, is an entrepreneur, author, e-commerce and middleman business activist. He is the CEO of Hukm Qalbi, founder/CEO/manager of a U.S.-based modern pet accessories brand, and author of *Hukm Qalbi* and *The Long Game: Moving Beyond the Checkpoint Mindset*. He holds OpenAI professional certificates in Agents and Workflows, Applied AI Foundations, and AI Foundations.

## Main Page

- [Saalim Zayed — Official Website](https://zayed-saalim.github.io/Zayed.com/): Single-page official website containing biography, books, image archive, leadership roles, certificates, press, social links, and contact form.

## Books

- [Hukm Qalbi](https://saalimzayed.github.io/HUKMQALBI/): Book on purpose, self-development, and living with intention. Publisher: Hukm Qalbi. Published 2024.
- [The Long Game: Moving Beyond the Checkpoint Mindset](https://zayed-saalim.github.io/the-long-game/): Book on patience, strategic thinking, and long-term meaning. Published 2024. Also on [Wikidata](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q140693199) and [Wikibooks](https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/The_Long_Game:_Moving_Beyond_the_Checkpoint_Mindset).

## Organization

- [Hukm Qalbi](https://saalimzayed.github.io/HUKMQALBI/): Initiative founded by Saalim Zayed in 2024, publishing works on purpose, discipline, and personal growth.
